meta.title: Tudigong Spirit Sign - S-Jiffy
meta.description: The Tudigong (Earth God) spirit sign has 32 lots, blessing the local land; suitable for asking about home, wealth, travel and other daily matters.
desc: The Tudigong (Earth God) spirit sign has 32 lots, blessing the local land; suitable for asking about home, wealth, travel and other daily matters.
ui.1: Silently recite your name and the matter you wish to ask, with sincerity and reverence, then draw a lot.
ui.2: This tool's data comes from public traditional culture materials and is for entertainment reference only.
